title: The King's Highway
changes: A wide cobbled highway now runs through Oakvale: from Hearthhold's gate at Goldenreach Farms to Oakvale, Millbrook Mill, Hunter's Camp and Saltmere, and on to the Red Road, Eastmarch and Greenward passes. Follow the cobbles and you never leave the road.
New signposts stand at the highway's forks and always point the way back to Goldenreach Farms and Oakvale.
The minimap and the world map show the highway in its own colour, with a Highways row in the legend.
